claim: On or about March 20, 2026, France's National Financial Prosecutor's office (the PNF) and the central office for combating corruption and financial crime searched the Paris offices of Edmond de Rothschild, the Swiss private bank, in a preliminary investigation arising from the released Epstein files. The probe centers on Fabrice Aidan, a former French diplomat who worked at the bank from 2014 to 2016; investigators are examining suspected bribery of a foreign public official and complicity. The Epstein documents released by the U.S. Department of Justice include emails in which Aidan — then special assistant to Terje Rød-Larsen, the United Nations Secretary-General's special envoy — corresponded directly with Jeffrey Epstein and forwarded him an official UN report, the Secretary-General's 16th semi-annual report on Security Council Resolution 1559, which he described as 'just released to the Security Council.' The French outlet Mediapart characterized the files as showing Aidan passing confidential UN material to Epstein. The bank said it was cooperating with investigators and had opened its own internal review. The search and the documents establish an active criminal investigation reaching a Rothschild-named institution, and direct Aidan–Epstein correspondence on the record; they do not, on their own, establish that any wrongdoing has been proven.

notes: The 'authorities searched a Rothschild property' news hook in capture DWS2NxBjV8U: the March 2026 French search of Edmond de Rothschild's Paris offices over former employee Fabrice Aidan's Epstein ties. Upgraded from wire-only sourcing to our own corpus primaries after a detective sweep: Aidan appears in 150+ corpus docs as Terje Rød-Larsen's UN special assistant, emailing Epstein from a un.org address. Lead primary EFTA01997651 (DS10) is Aidan forwarding Epstein the SG's 16th semi-annual Resolution 1559 report; EFTA01884968 (DS10) is clean two-way Aidan↔Epstein correspondence (Epstein's reply giving '22 avenue foch' Paris and '9 east 71 st' NY is captured at EFTA01884879). The doc shows Aidan forwarding an official UN report he described as 'just released to the Security Council'; whether that material was 'confidential' is Mediapart's characterization, attributed not adopted. 'Rothschild-named institution' (the Swiss Edmond de Rothschild group) avoids implying the family itself is under investigation, which is not established.
